claim: Patchline ships an interactive web companion where readers re-run every claim against live gates. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the live gates claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make interactive-web-companion-gate`.
